title: hypericum barbatum subsp. macedonicum
intro: Hypericum barbatum subsp. macedonicum, commonly known as Macedonian St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Hypericaceae. This plant has been used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing and reduce stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Macedonian St. John's Wort include its ability to exhibit antidepressant and antiseptic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
